map.金属-金属/复合材料粘接质量超声筛查：输入回波幅度、底波衰减、可疑信号数，按阈值: Ultrasonic screening of metal-to-metal / composite bonding quality: enter echo amplitude, bottom-wave attenuation and the number of suspect signals, and judge "bonding good / basically qualified / needs recheck / fail" against the thresholds.
map.大面积粘接面抽检：对检测面积较大的构件，用「可疑信号面积比」辅助判断缺陷密集程度: Spot checks on large bonded areas: for components with a large inspected area, use the "suspect signal area ratio" to help judge defect density and decide the sampling ratio.
map.复检决策：信号异常时给出「增大检测比例或辅以 X 射线」的建议，避免漏检脱粘。: Recheck decision: when the signal is abnormal, recommend "increasing the inspection ratio or supplementing with X-ray" to avoid missing debonding.
map.输入：回波幅度 −6 dB、底波衰减 3 dB、检测面积 100 cm²、可疑信: Input: echo amplitude −6 dB, bottom-wave attenuation 3 dB, inspected area 100 cm², suspect signals 2. Determination: echo ≥−6 dB normal, bottom-wave attenuation ≤4 dB normal, signal count ≤2 → basically qualified; suspect signal area ratio = 2/max(100/10,1)×100% = 20.0%. By comparison: 6 signals, echo −2 dB, attenuation 1 dB → fail (area ratio 60.0%); 0 signals, echo −3 dB, attenuation 2 dB → bonding good (area ratio 0%).
map.回波和底波分别看什么？: What do the echo and the bottom wave each tell you?
map.回波幅度反映缺陷（脱粘/气孔）引起的声能损失，越接近 0 dB 越好（本工具 ≥: The echo amplitude reflects the sound energy loss caused by defects (debonding / voids); the closer to 0 dB the better (this tool judges ≥−6 dB as good). The bottom-wave attenuation reflects sound coupling and the overall bonding state, with ≤4 dB being normal. The two combined are more reliable than either alone.
map.判「需复检」后怎么办？: What to do after it says "needs recheck"?
map.不要直接判废。应先提高检测比例、在可疑区加密扫查，或换 X 射线/热成像交叉验证: Do not scrap it outright. First raise the inspection ratio, scan the suspect area more densely, or cross-validate with X-ray / thermal imaging; only judge it a failure and re-bond when large-area debonding is confirmed. Ultrasonic methods are sensitive to non-contact debonding but may miss weakly bonded interfaces, which is why rechecking matters.

map.依据超声波探伤的回波与耦合数据，判断粘接界面的脱粘、分层等缺陷状况并给出合格判定: Use ultrasonic inspection echo and coupling data to judge debonding, delamination and other defects at the bond interface, with a pass/fail verdict for non-destructive quality inspection.
map.可疑信号密度（个/100cm²）= 信号数 ÷ 检测面积 × 100；缺陷面积比: Suspicious-signal density (count/100 cm²) = signal count ÷ inspection area × 100; defect area ratio (only when a valid defect area is entered) = defect area ÷ inspection area × 100, and overlapping defects are double-counted. This page only records readings and gives prompts; it does not calculate bond strength or judge acceptance.
map.金属-金属/复合材料粘接质量超声筛查：输入回波幅度、底波衰减、可疑信号数，记录读: Ultrasonic screening of metal-to-metal/composite bonds: enter echo amplitude, back-wall attenuation and suspicious-signal count; the tool records readings and signal density and gives a re-inspection prompt. It does not judge acceptance or strength.
map.大面积粘接面抽检：用「信号密度（个/100cm²）」判断可疑信号密集程度；只有实: Sampling of large bond areas: use signal density (count/100 cm²) to describe how densely suspicious signals occur. Only when a valid defect area is measured should you calculate an area ratio, and overlapping defects may be double-counted.
map.复检决策：信号异常时给出「增大检测比例或辅以 X 射线」的建议，避免漏检脱粘；阈: Re-inspection decision: when signals are abnormal, the tool suggests increasing inspection coverage or adding X-ray/thermal methods to avoid missing debonding. Thresholds and actions must be set by qualified personnel per the inspection procedure.
map.输入：回波幅度 −6 dB、底波衰减 3 dB、检测面积 100 cm²、可疑信: Input: echo −6 dB, attenuation 3 dB, inspection area 100 cm², 2 suspicious signals, no defect area. Signal density = 2÷100×100 = 2.0 per 100 cm²; the page only advises closer re-inspection, gives no acceptance verdict, and does not convert signal count into an area ratio. If a measured defect area of 20 cm² is entered, the area ratio = 20÷100×100 = 20.0%, but overlapping defects may be double-counted and it is not a net defect rate.
map.页面为什么不再判合格/不合格？: Why does the page no longer judge pass/fail?
map.信号数量无法反推缺陷面积，材料和胶种也不改变本页读数；合格阈值与处置必须由专业人: Signal count cannot be converted back into defect area, and material/adhesive do not change these readings. Acceptance thresholds and actions must be defined by qualified personnel for the specific procedure, material and joint. This page only records readings, signal density and re-inspection prompts. Ultrasonic testing is sensitive to open debonding but may miss weak interfaces, so re-inspection is still required.
